input.brief: Marketplace growth agency that grows Amazon and TikTok Shop brands on profit (TACoS, contribution margin), using the Halo Effect: TikTok demand lifts Amazon organic rank. Runs Amazon US UK CA DE UAE. Mountain hexagon logo, name Zion.

direction.name: Loud and flat
direction.idea: A page with the directness of a street poster: flat saturated colour, the heaviest type you can find, short blunt statements, and photographs cut out and stuck on. It is for subjects with a voice. Write the page as things a person would actually say out loud, and let the design say them at full volume. The craft is in the control beneath the noise: a strict grid, two or three colours, and exact alignment keep it from becoming a mess.
direction.composition: Hero: a statement of three to six words in ultra-heavy type at 11–15vw, filling the width, lines stacked tight (leading 0.85), flush left with 20–28px margins, on a flat saturated ground. One cut-out or hard-cropped photograph overlaps the type from the right or bottom, tilted 3–6 degrees. A single chunky button in the contrasting flat colour. Sections are solid panels in alternating palette colours: one is a row of short statements each on its own panel of unequal width; one is a single photograph bleeding off two edges with a caption block set over a solid colour bar; one is a large plain list. Panels meet edge to edge. Corners are square or use one large radius (28–40px) consistently.
direction.typography: The heaviest weight available, set tight, mostly lowercase or mostly uppercase (choose one). Body text is a plain grotesk at 18–20px.
direction.colour: Three or four flat colours at full strength including black or white. Each panel is one colour; text on it is one other.
direction.imagery: Photographs with attitude, cropped hard or cut to a simple shape with `clip-path` (circle, arch, blunt polygon), slightly rotated, overlapping the type. Two or three on the page.
direction.richness: Colour mass, type mass, and overlap.
direction.pitfalls: Headlines still obey the two-line rule: at 13vw that means very few words, which is correct for this voice. No outlines, no offset shadows, no sticker confetti. Rotation is for two or three images only, never for text blocks.

hero.name: Waterline headline
hero.blueprint: Two flat fields fill the viewport and meet at exactly half height: the upper one paper or white, the lower one a saturated palette colour. No image. The headline is two lines of capitals in a black-weight grotesk at clamp(72px, 9vw, 140px), centred, leading 0.86, about 65% of the viewport wide, positioned so the seam cuts through the middle of the second line. Above the seam the letters take the accent ink; below it they switch to a deep ink, as if under water. Build it with two stacked copies of the headline in the same position (the lower copy aria-hidden), each clipped to its own field with clip-path: inset(), or with mix-blend-mode: difference on a single copy if the colours allow. The wordmark sits top-left and the single action, a solid rectangle in the accent ink, top-right, both on 28px margins; there are no other links. Near the bottom, 40px above the edge, one supporting sentence at 20px is centred in the paper colour on the saturated field. Everything else is empty colour.
hero.mobile: The same two fields, meeting at 46% of the height. The headline sets at 15.5vw on two lines, filling the width inside 16px margins, the seam still cutting the second line. The wordmark sits top-left and the action top-right as a small solid rectangle. The supporting sentence sits bottom-left at 17px on the saturated field, on up to three lines.
hero.headline: A blunt statement of 2-4 words in capitals, at most 20 characters, split so each line is one or two words.

type.note: A tall American gothic taken from city signage, blunt and civic, over a plain public-service sans. Suits culture indexes, community projects, bars, sport clubs and local campaigns.

palette.name: Orange, sky, lime
palette.note: The page ground changes as you read: orange first, then sky blue, then acid lime at the end, with one near-black band between; type stays black on all three colours. Crimson is one small button per field.

motion.name: Masked headline
motion.description: On load, each line of the headline rises from behind its own baseline, about 900ms with a strong ease-out, the second line 110ms after the first; the supporting sentence and the action then fade up together. Nothing else on the page performs. Because headlines are two lines at most, you author the line breaks and wrap each line yourself. Recipe: 'Masked line reveal' in references/motion.md.

sections.name: The printed guest list
sections.blueprint: Names are printed on a card, the way a programme lists its patrons or an invitation its hosts. On a contrasting flat ground, a paper-coloured panel about 56% of the viewport wide with 5:7 proportions sits centred and rotated by one or two degrees; the section is shorter than the card and clips it with `overflow: hidden`, so the card is cut by the bottom edge rather than framed whole. Inside, 56px padding. At the top, a centred heading of two to four words at 28px. Below it the names run as centred lines at 20–22px with leading 1.7, several names to a line, separated by middots with a non-breaking space either side. One photograph may be tipped in between the heading and the names: 16:9, the full inner width, square corners. The card is a plain filled shape with no outline.
sections.mobile: The card becomes 92% of the screen wide, keeps a one-degree tilt and is still cut off by the section's bottom edge. Heading at 22px, names at 17px with two names to a line. Padding drops to 28px, and the tipped-in photograph keeps the full inner width.

sections.name: One verb at a time
sections.blueprint: Three to five full-bleed panels, each 100svh tall, stacked with no gap; each is one stage and holds one photograph covering it. In every panel a single word, the verb for that stage ('Cut', 'Fold', 'Stitch', 'Press'), is set at clamp(96px, 17vw, 300px), heavy and centred, inside a wrapper that is position: sticky; top: 50% and shifted up by half its own height. Because each word is sticky only within its own panel, it holds the centre of the screen while its photograph passes behind it, and is then pushed out by the next panel's verb. Use mix-blend-mode: difference in white, or one solid colour tested on every image. One sentence at 18px sits in the bottom-left corner of each panel over a neutral scrim limited to that corner. There is no separate heading: the verbs, read in order, are both the heading and the sequence.
sections.mobile: Panels stay 100svh, each photograph cropped to a vertical slice. The verb is 24vw, still sticky at the centre. The sentence sits along the bottom over a scrim at 16px, full width with 16px margins.

sections.name: Two giant words compared
sections.blueprint: No photographs: the thing shown is a pair of words, characters or figures that make the point by comparison (before and after, input and output, ours and the usual). At the top of the section, on one row: the heading, two to four words at 28–36px, at the left margin, and a paragraph of up to 60 words at 17px starting at column 7. Then 12vh of space. Below, two specimens side by side, one starting on column 1 and one on column 7, each set at clamp(180px, 34vw, 520px) with leading 0.8, so each fills about half the viewport's width. The section has a fixed height and overflow: hidden, so its bottom edge cuts both specimens at roughly 60% of their height. One short caption at 16px sits above the top-left of each specimen, naming it. Both specimens share one ink; the difference is in the letterforms or values, not in colour.
sections.mobile: Heading first, then the paragraph, at full width. The two specimens stack, each at 62vw type size in its own 38svh box with overflow hidden so the lower part is cut. Captions sit above each box at 15px. The second box takes the inverse colours of the first.

sections.name: Line-up at one type size
sections.blueprint: A full-bleed flat section. The programme is a four-column table spanning the full width between 24px margins, with every cell at one size, clamp(20px, 2.1vw, 30px), one weight, no bold: the act or session flush left, the format starting at 33%, the room or stage at 66%, and the time range right-aligned at the far edge with tabular figures. Rows are 1.5em tall and separated by nothing but that leading; the fixed column starts do the organising. Day or part headings are a single line at the same size in the accent ink with 72px above and 20px below, and may be `position: sticky; top: 0` on a strip of the section's ground colour so the current day stays in view. Breaks and changeovers are rows set in capitals in the soft ink. There is no other heading. Comfortably holds 12–40 rows; with fewer than eight, raise the size to 3vw.
sections.mobile: Each entry becomes two lines: the act at 22px on the first, then format, room and time on one line at 14px in the soft ink with the time right-aligned. 18px between entries. Day headings stay sticky at the top on the ground colour.

sections.name: Stacked folders with tabs
sections.blueprint: Projects are filed as folders: four to six full-width flat colour bands stacked so that each shows a 64px strip above the next, built with `position: sticky` and increasing `top` offsets (0, 64, 128px) so the bands pile up as the page scrolls. From the top-left edge of each band one or two tabs rise: filled shapes 44px tall and 200–320px wide with shouldered corners cut by `clip-path: polygon()` or an inline SVG path, side by side with 6px gaps, each in a flat colour that contrasts with its band. The project name sits inside the tab at 26–28px; the category sits right-aligned in the band's visible strip at 15px. An open band is 80svh: a 16:10 photograph in columns 1–7 and, top-aligned in columns 9–12, a 60-word description with a link. A two-word heading at 32px precedes the stack.
sections.mobile: Bands do not stick; they stack in normal flow, each led by one tab 40px tall with the name at 20px and the category beside it. Inside a band the photograph is full width at 4:3 with the description beneath at 16px and 20px padding.

sections.name: One figure owns the screen
sections.blueprint: One number, one screen. A flat field at least 90svh tall. At the top-left, starting on the page's main axis, a one-line claim of two to five words at 36–44px: this is the heading. Then a long gap of 22–28vh. At the bottom-left on the same edge, a single figure at clamp(180px, 23vw, 380px), leading 0.8, tight tracking, with its unit (a percent sign, 'x', 'hrs') set as a superscript one third of the figure's size and aligned to the figure's cap height. Directly beneath, flush with the figure's left edge, a caption of three lines at 16–17px, 32ch wide, saying exactly what was measured and when. The right half of the field stays empty; resist filling it. The figure is static text in lining numerals and does not animate. A source line, if needed, sits at the bottom-right at 15px.
sections.mobile: The claim sits at the top at 28px. The figure is 46vw, flush left, with its superscript unit; if it has four characters or more, drop it to 34vw so it stays on one line. The caption follows at 16px across 80% of the width. Minimum height 80svh.

sections.name: Side facts, wide paragraph
sections.blueprint: Two rows share one vertical line at 34% of the viewport width. Row one: in a 160px column at the left margin, three label and value pairs stack with 20px between them, each a label in the soft ink with its value beneath in full ink, all at 13px (founded, based in, team size). From the 34% line a five-line paragraph at clamp(20px, 1.7vw, 26px), leading 1.35, runs to 90% of the width. Row two starts 120px lower and repeats the logic for the record of the practice: one plain word at 13px at the far left (awards, press, clients), then from the 34% line two list columns, each 260px wide with a 64px gutter, at 13px with 10px between lines: name at the left, year at the right in the soft ink. No heading; the paragraph opens the section. Each list comfortably holds 6–12 lines. No photographs are needed.
sections.mobile: Everything aligns to the left margin. The paragraph comes first at 19px. The three label and value pairs follow as a two-column grid at 14px. The two record lists stack with 40px between them, each opened by its plain word in full ink.

sections.name: A band per question
sections.blueprint: Each question owns a full-bleed band, and the bands alternate between two flat tones (ground and one step away, or two palette colours with their assigned inks) and butt together with no gap. Inside every band the same grid applies: the question in columns 1–5 at 28–32px bold, top-aligned with 56px of padding above; the answer in columns 7–12 at 18px with leading 1.5, the same padding, and 56px below. Bands are as tall as their content, so their heights differ, which gives the stack its rhythm. Four to seven bands. The heading is the first band: two to four words at about 7vw on the accent colour, flush left, taller than the rest at about 40svh with the words anchored to its bottom-left. All answers are visible; there are no toggles.
sections.mobile: Bands stay full-bleed and alternate. Inside each, the question at 22px then the answer at 17px, with 32px padding top and bottom and 20px at the sides. The heading band is 30svh tall with its words at 13vw at the bottom-left.

sections.name: Question at both edges
sections.blueprint: For a closing choice between two answers: book or ask, this date or that, the tasting or the tour. A flat field exactly 100svh tall in the darkest tone. The question is a two-line heading at clamp(110px, 11vw, 168px), leading 1.0, centred, about 54% of the width: line one with its cap line 32px under the field's top edge, line two with its baseline 24px above the bottom edge. The band of about 560px between them is empty except for one row at its optical centre: two solid rectangular buttons, each about 200×56px with its label at 18px in medium weight, their inner edges 120px either side of the centre axis, and between them, exactly on the axis, the word 'or' at 18px in the soft ink. 16px under the row, centred, one line at 16px in the soft ink says what happens after either choice. The type above and below closes the empty band, so it reads as held breath rather than a gap.
sections.mobile: The question drops to 18vw, still two centred lines, line one 32px from the top and line two 24px above the bottom. The buttons stack at the centre at 72% of the width, 12px apart, with 'or' between them and the line of explanation under the second.

sections.name: The mark, built large
sections.blueprint: On a flat colour field, the brand closes the page as a construction rather than as set type. Across the full content width and about 34svh tall, the wordmark is built from blocks: each letter is knocked out of its own solid rectangle in a palette colour, the rectangles differ in height (60–100% of the band) and butt together with 4px gaps, bottoms on one line. Where the project has a simple geometric mark or motif, enlarge that instead, drawn as inline SVG from flat rectangles, circles and quarter-arcs with the same 4px gaps. Below, 56px lower: four columns of plain links at 15px across columns 1–8, and two addresses or contact lines in columns 9–12. A last row carries the copyright at the left and one small filled button at the right. Space and the block construction do all the separating.
sections.mobile: The block wordmark spans the full width at about 22svh tall; a long name breaks into two rows of blocks. Link columns go two across at 15px, contact lines beneath at full width, then copyright and the small button on one row.

references.name: UGLYCASH
references.idea: A money app sold like streetwear: one shouted condensed headline over the phone, then sticker-covered 3D props where feature icons would normally go.
references.hero: Near-white page. A floating light-grey nav bar only 35% of the viewport wide sits centred 20px from the top: condensed wordmark left, two social icons in the middle, an app button with a glowing magenta outline right. Directly beneath, a two-line uppercase headline in bold condensed grotesque at 11.4vw, centred, leading under 0.9, about 60% of the width, with a faint cyan and magenta fringe on the letter edges; it fills the band from 12% to 43% of the height. A single phone mockup 27% of the viewport wide rises immediately under the headline, centred, cut off by the bottom edge. Its magenta screen glow is the only colour.
references.type: Helvetica Now Display Condensed Bold in capitals at 164px with -0.033em tracking and very tight leading; the same face in mixed case near 34px for section headings. Inter at 14px, semi-bold, for captions. Two faces and a roughly 12:1 jump.
references.colour: #f7f7f7 #000000 #ffffff #ff00e6 #b6ff00 #00aeef — Off-white ground, white cards, black type. Neon magenta, lime and cyan appear only as whole-card fills, glows and stickers, never in text. Cool and synthetic overall.
references.imagery: Phone mockups with real app screens, plus glossy 3D props (money bags, a holographic card, an eagle, a wet-floor sign, banknotes) covered in die-cut stickers, each centred in a rounded card; some cards have grainy neon gradients.
references.layout: Content sits in a centred column about 60% of the viewport wide. Sections open with a left-aligned condensed heading, then rows of two or three rounded cards with captions placed outside and below. A horizontal carousel and a centred uppercase statement break the rhythm.

sections.description: A left-aligned two-line condensed heading near 34px above a row of three equal cards with 8px gaps and small radius: one pale grey with a cropped balance readout and tilted stickers, one white with two 3D money bags, one solid cyan with a phone cropped at the bottom. Captions sit beneath each card rather than inside: a bold one-word title and two short 13px lines.

Two near-square cards side by side, each half the column. Left: a grainy lime-to-lilac gradient with a white floating panel listing three rows, each with a flag, a label and a small pill button. Right: a white card with a black holographic payment card tilted about 25 degrees, stickers stuck to it. A later pair repeats the pattern with a solid magenta card holding a white icon-grid panel.

Trust carousel: a horizontal row of tall cards, each showing one 3D object centred (a chrome eagle on white, a banknote on solid lime, a yellow wet-floor sign with hand-lettered warning). The title sits inside the first card and below the others. A tiny two-dot pager is centred underneath and the next card peeks in orange at the right edge of the column.

A white rounded panel the width of the column in which the wordmark is scaled to fill the panel edge to edge, about 55% of the viewport, in black ultra-condensed capitals. Beneath it, one row with a small parent-brand credit at left and two store badges at right, then legal small print in 11px at left and four right-aligned links.

steal: Make the nav a short floating bar a third of the viewport wide so the headline can start almost at the top edge.
Replace feature icons with one photoreal 3D prop per card, each covered in die-cut stickers, and keep captions outside the card.
End with the wordmark scaled to exactly fill a white footer card, with all legal text beneath it at 11px.

references.name: Aardvark Book Club
references.idea: A book club dressed as a sweet shop: fat black type, tumbling 3D books and boxes on wavy colour fields, annotated with handwritten asides.
references.hero: A saturated yellow field with two large wavy blobs, pale yellow then orange, rising from the bottom. A three-line headline in Champ Bold, black, at about 8.3vw with leading under 0.85, is flush to a 15px left margin and reaches 60% across. Beneath it: a four-line paragraph 310px wide and a magenta split button (label plus arrow square). Right of centre a 3D hardback in navy and pink tilts 20 degrees, 600px tall; another book is cropped by the top-left corner, a third by the bottom edge. A purple handwritten note sits rotated at far right. Nav: pale-yellow pill links centred, an orange login button, black round social icons.
references.type: Champ Bold, an ultra-heavy wide sans with a looped g, for headings at 120px with tight tracking and leading; Degular for 18px body and pill labels; a purple handwritten script (Hello Organichand) for rotated margin notes and step labels. Three distinct voices.
references.colour: #ffd249 #faed8f #f9a21f #ffdbfd #a4f6f8 #fd48f2 — Each section owns one flat candy colour: yellow hero, white shelf, pink steps, cyan unboxing, deep violet footer. Type stays black; buttons are magenta.
references.imagery: 3D-rendered hardbacks and a patterned shipping box, cut out and tilted, floating over flat wavy vector shapes; real book covers on tilted coloured cards; black line drawings of figures on step cards. Nothing sits square to the grid.
references.layout: Sections are full-width panels with roughly 80px corner radius inset about 20px from the viewport, each a different colour. Headings alternate left and centre; cards overlap and rotate a few degrees; handwritten notes are tucked beside headings at an angle.

sections.description: White band. A centred black heading at 5.5vw over a two-line subline, with a rotated handwritten note at its upper left. Below, a horizontal row of book covers, each on a rounded colour-matched card with a small tag pill at top-left; cards tilt alternately by 3 degrees at staggered heights, the last cropped by the right edge, with two round arrow buttons above at right. Later, covers give way to same-coloured info cards with genre pills, heavy title and blurb.

A pale-pink rounded panel with lighter wavy shapes inside. Heavy black heading at left with a handwritten aside beside it; a small round logo stamp and a magenta split button at right. Along the bottom, four portrait cards about 250px wide in cyan, magenta, yellow and violet overlap like a fanned hand, each rotated a few degrees, with a handwritten step label at top, a black line drawing in the middle and a heavy caption at the foot.

A full-viewport cyan rounded panel containing only a 3D shipping box wrapped in a wavy magenta, violet and black pattern, centred. Across the scroll it goes from closed and tilted to lid open, growing to about 57% of the viewport width, with a single handwritten note at its right. No heading and no button.

The preceding white section ends in large rounded bottom corners over a deep violet footer. Left: white logo, two store badges, two magenta round social icons. Centre: the patterned box again, cropped by the bottom edge. Right: a small heavy heading, a white rounded email field and a magenta split button. A black legal strip closes the page.

steal: Give each section one flat saturated colour inside a large-radius inset panel and keep the type black across all of them.
Add rotated handwritten margin notes beside headings to carry secondary facts in a second voice.
Fan step cards so they overlap and tilt instead of sitting in an even grid.
references.media: About 60% of the first screen is picture: a 3D book and cropped book corners over a full-bleed illustrated wave field. Below come a sticky image-sequence of a box opening inside a rounded panel, a slider of tilted cards bleeding off the right edge, covers fanned like a hand of cards, a sticker collage round a circular badge and a cut-out box rising out of the footer: 37 images and two scroll-scrubbed canvases, no video.
references.motion: An indigo transition panel wipes away by 1.2s while the headline arrives word by word (515 split characters), and Lenis then drives the scrubbed scenes: the hero book turns through an image sequence, a sticky stage scrubs the box opening over 2745px, a headline slides along a curved path at scrub 0.5, and the footer is uncovered from under the rounded page. Buttons squash to 0.955 by 0.925 in 0.15s on press, the main ease is cubic-bezier(0.32,0.72,0,1), and the bounce overshoots are ones the house motion layer does not use, though the site ships 32 reduced-motion rules.

references.name: RSquad
references.idea: The six letters of the name are detached red monospace glyphs that float over the whole page and reshuffle their constellation as you scroll, while the actual content sits quietly underneath in tiny mono.
references.hero: White viewport with no imagery. Three tiny uppercase mono nav words sit on the top edge at far left, exact centre and far right, the active one underlined. The wordmark is exploded into six red monospace capitals, each about 12% of viewport height, placed on a loose ring roughly 45% of the viewport wide: R alone at top centre, S and D at mid-left and mid-right, Q and A lower, U at bottom centre, with three small red vertical blocks as punctuation between them. Inside the ring sits a two-line 20px mono tagline, a small hooked arrow and one underlined text link. The outer thirds are empty.
references.type: Elma Mono Variable at weight 300, uppercase, 20px for nav, taglines and body; the red letters are the same mono enlarged about six times. Cortese Trial, a light flared serif in tight capitals, sets pull quotes at about 4.4vw; Inter for small link captions. Three sizes in total.
references.colour: #ffffff #fa2420 #111111 #000000 #d9d9d9 — White ground with thin black text and one saturated signal red reserved for the floating letters and blocks; the closing screen inverts to black with white and red line ornaments.
references.imagery: No photographs. The red letters are the imagery, plus small engraved-style ornamental roman numerals inside dotted selection boxes and, on the last black screen, white line-drawn vines with red star flowers.
references.layout: One centred column about a third of the viewport wide with huge side margins. Sections are short centred stacks: ornamental numeral, two-word title, mono paragraph, then two or three columns of underlined links with one-line captions. Wide serif quotes break the narrow rhythm.

sections.description: Chapter block: at top centre a tall dotted-outline box with tiny square corner handles, like a selected frame in a design tool, holds an engraved roman numeral and a two-word stacked title; dotted diagonals fan out beneath it like a tent. Below comes a centred two-line mono paragraph, then a row of two or three underlined project names, each marked by a small black square above and a one-line sans caption below.

Pull quote in light serif capitals at roughly 4.4vw, centred, five tightly leaded lines about 60% of viewport width, wrapped in guillemets and filling the top half of the screen. Red mono letters and blocks pass over and between the words, deliberately colliding with the text. No attribution, rule or card; the next numbered chapter box starts directly below.

A three-line mono paragraph centred at the top, then three short sans statements arranged as a triangle (two side by side, one below centre), each topped by a small black square. The block ends with a two-line serif-capitals sign-off at about 4vw, centred, with the red letters clustered directly on top of it.

Closing screen flips to solid black: a second serif-capitals quote in white, centred, with one small mono line above it. White line-drawn vines and red star flowers creep in from the lower corners and right edge, and the red letters now run in a loose vertical chain through the quote. The three-word nav stays pinned in white.

steal: Break the wordmark into single glyphs and place them as a loose ring around the tagline, keeping the centre for a two-line statement and one text link.
Use one typeface at only two extremes (20px mono for everything, the same mono at six times the size in the accent colour) and bring in a serif-capitals face solely for quotes.
Mark chapters with a dotted selection box with corner handles around an ornamental numeral instead of a heading bar or eyebrow.
